payload.title: Sync accepted entities into draft wiki page Items
payload.description:
As an editor, I want a draft page created for each accepted entity, so that I only review and publish rather than author each page.

Front matter: entity id, kind, aliases, beat, related keys, optional pin and annotations. Body: the approved description in Markus (descriptions may be LLM-drafted but are published only after a human accepts; default model for language-model tasks is GPT-6 Luna unless stated otherwise). The node remains the system of record.

```gherkin
Feature: Entity page sync
  Scenario: New accepted entity
    Given an entity newly accepted by the desk
    When the sync runs
    Then a draft page Item exists for it and is not public

  Scenario: Publish
    When an editor publishes the draft
    Then the page appears in the wiki listing, sitemap and search index

  Scenario: Never auto-publish
    Then the sync never sets a page to published

  Scenario: Description changed
    Given a published page whose entity description changed
    Then the sync creates a pending revision for review rather than altering the live page
```
